entries.title: fall back to device credential when biometrics lock out
entries.description: Locked apps no longer become unopenable after too many failed fingerprint or face attempts.

entries.title: show the unlock prompt for locked apps in a work profile
entries.description: Locked work profile apps no longer bounce straight back to the home screen when tapped.

entries.title: use the solid prompt when a locked app is already on screen
entries.description: A locked app coming back from the recents screen is covered as soon as the prompt starts instead of staying readable behind it.

entries.title: lock apps reopened from the recents screen without a launch
entries.description: Locked apps no longer open without authentication when you return to them from the recents screen.

entries.title: drop the unused context parameter from usableAuthenticators
scope the Samsung sensor-class match to Samsung devices
add native OEM face unlock for Samsung and Xiaomi
entries.description: Locked apps can now be unlocked with the built-in face scanner on Samsung and Xiaomi devices, where the standard prompt does not offer it.

entries.title: re-issue a blocked screen pin once the app is unlocked
entries.description: Pinning a locked app from recents now pins it after the unlock prompt is passed, instead of opening the app unpinned.

entries.title: skip the uninstall prompt for versioned library packages
entries.description: Chrome and WebView updates no longer raise the biometric prompt while removing the old copy of their shared library.

entries.title: find hook logs when the Xposed framework is not LSPosed
entries.description: Shared logs now include the hook log on Xposed forks that keep it outside LSPosed's own folder.

entries.title: relock an app left right after it was unlocked
entries.description: Locked apps now ask for authentication again when reopened after briefly going to the home screen.
